scope: Strategy eligibility only; no quantity/risk changes, parameter optimization or release permission. A strategy must have positive matching-asset evidence and positive strategy/state pooled evidence, stressed expectancy and a positive one-sided normal weekly-cluster lower estimate.
chronology: Labels enter only after exit candle closes. At every event use trailing180days; matching strategy and existing adaptive-market state at entry. No random split or current-trade label. Research only; initial strategies were researched using these dates already.
arbitration: Existing canonical arbitrator among admitted candidates; independent fixed-score baseline for comparison. One active per asset; no winner means no trade.
